description: Register a permanent DevGlow project WITHOUT running it. This is how you 'add a project to DevGlow' — there is no config file to author (no devglow.json / DEVGLOW.md); calling this tool IS the registration. Use it for bulk registration when you want to record metadata only (no port binding, no browser tab, no dependency install). To start the project later, call start_project. Use run_process instead when you need to actually launch a server for verification or one-off work.

command.description: Shell command to run when the user starts the project.

description.description: What the app does, plus any notes worth keeping (max 1000 chars).

interactive.description: Run in a PTY (interactive terminal) so tty-driven tools like `flutter run` / `expo start` enter interactive mode and accept key input (hot reload r, restart R). DEFAULT: omit — the command is auto-detected (flutter run, expo start, metro, react-native start ⇒ on). Only set explicitly to override that detection (true to force on, false to force plain pipe).

port.description: Port number the command listens on, if any. Used for the Open ↗ button.

tags.description: Tags. DEFAULT: omit (no tags). Tags are the user's manual grouping system — do NOT auto-fill with technology guesses (e.g., 'db', 'test', 'api'). Only set this when the new project clearly belongs to a tag already used by an existing project (see list_projects). Reuse verbatim.

name: create_project
title: Create a permanent project (without running)
